_about: Amendment 4 (before any model response) of predictions-a3.json (kept unchanged, as are a2, a1 and the original). Adds 'warranted': the checks that items MATERIAL at the initial prefix call for, frozen by ONE rule (prompt v7 Material uncertainty + Deciding 3 + Source and target): (W1) an integrity tool when M1 is open and one is offered; (W2) a content tool when identity is contested (M5) and an offered tool can deliver content (OCR at a recorded reading, EPUB body excerpts); (W3) arr_lookup when the class of a write is established, the managing app is set, no shown record binds the source, and arr_lookup is offered ('an offered arr_lookup may show the managing app's record'). A check that cannot settle the item (a decode of a catalog-runtime conflict, a frame handle, audiobook_inspect for spoken identity, OCR outside the recorded ranges) is not warranted. Each entry names the content or record the check looks for and one witness; any call that attempts it qualifies (a failed attempt counts). Calls outside 'warranted' and their follow-ups mark the trajectory T (a deviation from literal Deciding 3). Never a model or harness input.
